name: Chicken Salad with Cucumbers, Peaches, Mint, Goat Cheese & Almonds

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 hearts romaine hearts
1 ½ English cucumbers
3 peaches
1 small pkg fresh mint

instructions.primary_message: Chop or tear lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Place in a large bowl.
Trim and quarter cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl with the lettuce.
Quarter peaches lengthwise (around the pit); twist quarters to separate, then remove and discard pits. Slice each quarter into thin wedges. Add to the bowl.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Place chickens on the cutting board and, using your hands, remove meat from the skin and bones. Separate the meat into shred-like pieces and add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (850 g) whole chickens rotisserie chicken, white and dark meat

instructions.primary_message: Crumble goat cheese into the bowl. Add almonds, vinaigrette, salt, and pepper, then toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (113 g) logs goat cheese
1 cup almonds, sliced
1 cup French vinaigrette
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: rotisserie chicken, white and dark meat
